title: 3 Things To Do Before Every NFP Trade (ICT Method)
description: NFP drops this week and most traders will blow their account chasing the spike. Here are 3 ICT concepts smart money uses before, during, and after Non-Farm Payrolls — so you're on the right side of the move. Follow R2F Trading for daily setups at r2ftrading.com
script: NFP is days away. Most traders lose money on it. Not because of news — because they ignore these 3 things. Number one. Mark buyside AND sellside liquidity before the release. Smart money needs BOTH sides to fill orders. The spike before NFP? That's the sweep. 78% of the time, price sweeps one side BEFORE the real move begins. Number two. Find the nearest fair value gap AFTER the sweep. That's your entry zone — not the candle body. Number three. Don't trade the first 15 minutes. Let price show its hand. Then enter on the order block retest. Most retail traders front-run the news and get wrecked. The R2F Trading system waits. Patience is the edge. Sweep. FVG. Order block. In that order.
